title: TD Talk: pin messages and see them in a bar under the chat header
text: The message menu in TD Talk now has Pin and Unpin. The newest pinned message shows in a bar under the chat header: tap it to jump to the message, press X to unpin, or use the arrow to step through several pins. Pins are shared by everyone in the chat and are the same pins the CRM Team Chat shows.
points: Pinning needs a connection. It does not work offline.
The Marketing chat's pinned bar is unchanged.
